name: Mukou no Yume
source:
For reasons completely unknown, Chisato Mikogami kills herself. She comes back as a ghost and wanders the earth, meeting the many interesting spirits and ghosts that make up the afterlife. Like Fishman, a fish spirit with a grudge against Chisato; Chisato's crazy sister who experiments on her, Chiyu; and their insanely powerful Mom.

[From [url=http://visual-novels.net/vn/index.php?option=com_content&task=view&id=283&Itemid=52]V-N.net[/url]]
translation:
御子神千里出于无人知晓的原因自杀身亡。她以幽灵之身重返世间，四处游荡，并遇见构成死后世界的诸多奇异灵魂与鬼怪：例如对千里怀恨在心的鱼灵“鱼人”；把千里当作实验对象的疯狂妹妹千悠；以及力量强得离谱的母亲。

[摘自[url=http://visual-novels.net/vn/index.php?option=com_content&task=view&id=283&Itemid=52]V-N.net[/url]]
